title: Bug 642555: [master] [NL] SEPA Direct Debit Export (Report 11000015 – pain.008.001.08) exports unstructured address instead of structured
summary: The SEPA Direct Debit export now formats debtor, creditor, and related addresses as structured XML elements with street, postal code, town, and country instead of a single unstructured text line, as required by banks.
key_points: Address elements now exported as structured XML fields (<StrtNm>, <PstCd>, <TwnNm>, <Ctry>) instead of unstructured <AdrLine>
Applies to debtor, creditor, ultimate creditor, and ultimate debtor addresses
Each address element is only written when it contains a value
Aligns Dutch SEPA Direct Debit export with bank requirements
quote: Banks require the address to be provided in structured form.
